findings.finding: Branch new-version holds two unmerged commits (6cbcdac, 7ac2a6c, 2026-11-09, by the repository owner): migrations 0052-0067, about 21,000 lines, covering cost forecasting with CPI, IFRS 15 revenue, change/variation links, subcontracts and their payments, fixed assets, period end, cash plan, role adjustments, payroll, consolidation, tax, workforce and HSE, quality and site, documents, credit rules.
findings.consequence: The migration versions collide with this branch's 0052-0057 and the runner refuses duplicates; documents, document_revisions, rfis and equipment are defined differently on each line.
findings.decision: Integrate on this branch (ADR 0025): carry the non-colliding work with renumbered migrations and both lines' tests; rebuild the colliding parts (transmittals, submittals, timesheets, HSE, internal hire) on this branch's document and equipment tables.
